# .github

## Purpose

Configuracion de GitHub para automatizacion del repositorio.

## Who Uses This Folder

- Quality Agent during CI and verification sprints.
- Implementation Agent only when a sprint authorizes CI/CD changes.
- GitHub Actions runtime.

## Contains

- Future or existing workflow definitions.
- Repository automation metadata.

## Never Contains

- Application source code.
- Business logic.
- Secrets or credentials.
- Manual sprint evidence.
- Product or architecture decisions.
